ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=x+b$ intersects with the line $y=kx+6$ at the point $P(1,3)$. What is the solution set for the inequality $x+b>kx+6$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $x>1$, we have $x+b>kx+6$,\\
which means the solution set of the inequality $x+b>kx+6$ is $x>1$,\\
therefore, the answer is $x>1$.\\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{x>1}$.
